3	webERP is a PHP/MySQL ERP. This whole is made of five areas: schema upgrade and migration, install/seed/API/test/admin, the order-to-cash, procure-to-pay, stock and master-data pages, the money-handling pages, and the report writer with document output. It takes browser requests, session state and CLI/cron runs. It hands work to MySQL/MariaDB, the filesystem, Dompdf, `SendEmailFromWebERP` (SMTP), FTP/EDI targets, gettext tools and Google/Nominatim feeds.
4	
5	## Areas
6	
7	- **Database upgrade and migration**: carries a database from 2.7 to the current schema. It has two paths:
8	
9	  - version-named SQL files run by `UpgradeDatabase.php`, tracked by `config.VersionNumber`;
10	
11	  - numbered PHP scripts `sql/updates/N.php` run by `Z_UpgradeDatabase.php`, tracked by `DBUpdateNumber`.
12	
13	  It also holds backup, one-off `Z_Upgrade_*` pages and helper libraries. It takes administrator requests and writes to the database. The application reads the result back through `GetConfig.php`.
14	
15	## Conventions
16	
17	- **Validation and transactions:** most pages validate first and then write.
18	
19	  - Posting pages use `DB_Txn_Begin`/`Commit`, and `GetNextTransNo` allocates numbers under a lock.
20	
21	  - `DB_query` prints and exits on error unless the caller turns trapping off.
22	
23	  - `DB_Txn_Rollback` only issues `ROLLBACK`. It does not reset autocommit to 1. Every statement after a rollback therefore opens a new implicit transaction, which the page's closing `DB_Txn_Commit` commits (`includes/ConnectDB_mysqli.php:196-212`).
24	
25	- **Location and account visibility:** location visibility uses `locationusers` (`canview` for reads, `canupd` for edits). GL account lists use `glaccountusers`. The check usually covers the list or load query, not the posting request.
26	
27	- **GL balance check:** most posters call `EnsureGLEntriesBalance` before commit: credit notes, stock adjustments, GRN, counter sales, supplier invoice and customer receipts.
28	
29	  - **Beyond tolerance:** it rolls back the writes made before the check, yet the page still reports success. Any writes after the check are committed by the closing `DB_Txn_Commit`.
30	
31	    - `CounterSales.php` calls `EnsureGLEntriesBalance(10)` before its receipt inserts. `CounterReturns.php` calls `EnsureGLEntriesBalance(11)` before its receipt inserts.
32	
33	    - A type 10 or 11 imbalance therefore leaves the type 12 `gltrans`, `banktrans`, `debtortrans` and `custallocns` rows committed. The `custallocns` row points at a `debtortrans` id whose insert was rolled back.
34	
35	    - Evidence: `includes/SQL_CommonFunctions.php:346-373`, `CounterSales.php:1851-2003`, `CounterReturns.php:1437-1580`.
36	
37	  - **Within tolerance:** it applies the rounding difference to an arbitrary `gltrans` row. The query groups by `counterindex` (one row per group) with no `ORDER BY`, so `MAX(amount)` does not select the largest line.
38	
39	    - Rounding can land on a tax, freight or bank line.
40	
41	    - Through the update trigger, this moves that account's `gltotals`, so a bank or tax control account can drift by cents from `banktrans` or the tax reports (`includes/SQL_CommonFunctions.php:359-370`).
42	
43	  - **Called after commit:** `ConfirmDispatch_Invoice.php` calls it after commit, so the unbalanced invoice stays posted.
44	
45	- **Upgrade scripts:**
46	
47	  - **Foreign keys:** foreign keys are off only until the first helper statement.
48	
49	    - `Z_UpgradeDatabase.php` sets `FOREIGN_KEY_CHECKS=0` once per file.
50	
51	    - `executeSQL` and `CreateTable` wrap each statement in `DB_IgnoreForeignKeys`/`DB_ReinstateForeignKeys`, which turns checks back on.
52	
53	    - A raw `DB_query` placed after a helper call runs with FK checks on. An FK error there exits the page mid-upgrade.
54	
55	    - Evidence: `Z_UpgradeDatabase.php:36-48`, `Z_UpgradeDatabase.php:128-135`, `includes/UpgradeDB_mysqli.php:518-530`.
56	
57	  - **SQL-file runs:** these continue past errors.
58	
59	  - **PHP updates:** these share one `Errors` counter for the whole run.
60	
61	    - Updates 0-16 and 25-35 record their number only when `Errors==0`. Updates 17-24 and the newest, 36-40, call `UpdateDBNo` unconditionally.
62	
63	    - After any error, later guarded updates are skipped while an unguarded one moves `DBUpdateNumber` past them. The next run starts at `DBUpdateNumber+1`, so the skipped updates never run. For example, an error in 33 stops 34 and 35 from recording, then 36 records 36.
64	
65	    - Evidence: `Z_UpgradeDatabase.php:50-57`, `Z_UpgradeDatabase.php:121-139`, `sql/updates/35.php:17-19`, `sql/updates/36.php:1-5`, `sql/updates/40.php:6-7`.
66	
67	    - Rule: always wrap `UpdateDBNo` in the `Errors==0` guard. The newest scripts, which new updates are copied from, lack it.
68	
69	- **Differences between siblings:**
70	
71	  - Receipt, credit note and order-invoice API calls roll back only on collected errors. `InsertSalesInvoice` and similar commit before checking.
72	
73	  - **Allocation paths:**
74	
75	    - The supplier allocation path passes `Transaction=true` on every write, so `DB_query` rolls back and exits on error (`SupplierAllocations.php:107-240`).
76	
77	    - In the customer path, the `$Error`/`DB_Txn_Rollback` branch can never run, because `DB_query` traps the error and exits first. Its rollback depends on the connection closing with autocommit=0 still set, not on code (`CustomerAllocations.php:86-205`, `includes/ConnectDB_mysqli.php:57-93`).
78	
79	- **Report pages:** they post to themselves, choose output with `PrintPDF`/`View`, and use shared Dompdf options.
80	
81	## Hazards
82	
83	  - Update 17 sets the run-wide Updates `Errors` and `Successes` counters back to 0 in the middle of a run (`sql/updates/17.php:10-49`).
84	
85	  - This wipes errors from updates 0-16 in the same run. Later guarded scripts then record anyway, and the summary screen hides the failure.
86	
87	  - Update 17 drops the `gltrans` triggers before rebuilding `gltotals` (`sql/updates/17.php:52-90`).
88	
89	  - Any trapped `DB_query` error during the rebuild exits the page with the triggers gone (`includes/ConnectDB_mysqli.php:57-93`). From then on, postings stop updating `gltotals`.
90	
91	  - The rebuild loads only chartmaster × periods pairs, so `gltrans` rows for unknown accounts or periods are left out of `gltotals`.
92	
93	- **Success shown after rollback:** a GL imbalance rolls back only the writes made before the check. The page still reports success and clears the cart.
94	
95	  - Writes made after the check are committed by the closing `DB_Txn_Commit`. In counter sales and returns, these are the receipt, bank entry and allocation.
96	
97	  - In SupplierInvoice, later writes probably land in an implicit transaction that the closing commit then commits.
98	
99	- **Seed drift:**
100	
101	  - The installer grants authority to the literal user 'admin' rather than the name chosen.
102	
103	  - `install/sql/data/config.sql` carries demo values into real companies.
104	
105	  - The demo installer ignores the typed company name.
106	
107	  - Demo and production seeds disagree on supplier-role tokens, so demo supplier users are not detected as suppliers.
108	
109	  - CI tests only the demo install, so non-demo install breakage goes unseen.
110	
111	- **Mixed-state results:** the upgrade scripts can leave tables the pages expect to be absent or changed.
112	
113	  - **`chartdetails`:** script 20 drops it (`sql/updates/20.php:9`), and the install schema has no such table.
114	
115	    - The GL reports read `gltotals`, not `chartdetails` (`GLAccountCSV.php:209`).
116	
117	    - The breakage is in the utilities. `Z_ChangeGLAccountCode.php` runs `ChangeFieldInTable('chartdetails')` with `Transaction=true`. On every database after update 20, and on every fresh install, it rolls back and exits (`Z_ChangeGLAccountCode.php:52-76`, `includes/MiscFunctions.php:556-564`).
118	
119	    - `Z_CheckDebtorsControl.php:87` still selects from `chartdetails`.
120	
121	  - **Reversing utilities:** some `Z_` utilities reverse documents without fixing balances.
122	
123	  - **Charset differences:** upgraded and fresh databases differ.
124	
125	    - `CreateTable` hard-codes `DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8`, so tables created by PHP updates are utf8mb3. The installer creates the same tables as utf8mb4 (`includes/UpgradeDB_mysqli.php:518-530`, `install/sql/tables/auditscript.sql:1-9`).
126	
127	    - Update 30 changes only the database default, not `CreateTable`'s explicit charset (`sql/updates/30.php:3-22`).
128	
129	    - An update that adds a varchar FK from such a table to a utf8mb4 table will fail on MySQL 8.
130	
131	  - **Update 38:** it checks for a table called 'auditscript' but creates 'auditscripts', so its existence check never matches (`sql/updates/38.php:1-16`). Re-running it fails with 'table exists', yet the version is still recorded because 38 has no guard.
132	
133	- **Injection and permissions:**
134	
135	  - Request values are concatenated into SQL almost everywhere.
136	
137	  - Permission checks are mostly absent on posting pages, destructive `Z_` utilities, mail scripts and the upgrade pages.
138	
139	  - `Z_DataExport` exports user passwords.
140	
141	  - Passwords are stored in plain text in the session and `emailsettings`.
142	
143	- **Exchange rate and period gaps:** zero exchange rates are unchecked across imports, API, payments and revaluation.
144	
145	  - `GetPeriod` creates periods without a cap and without `gltotals` rows.
146	
147	    - `CreatePeriod` builds the `gltotals` INSERT but never runs it, because the `DB_query` call is missing (`includes/DateFunctions.php:1225-1239`).
148	
149	    - `GetPeriod`'s first-period bootstrap adds no rows either (`includes/DateFunctions.php:1307-1311`).
150	
151	  - `gltotals` rows exist only because the `gltrans` insert trigger upserts them (`install/sql/triggers/gltrans_after_insert.sql:1-6`).
152	
153	    - The update and delete triggers use a plain UPDATE (`install/sql/triggers/gltrans_after_update.sql:14-18`).

content.text:
Revaluation of foreign-currency bank accounts now posts to its own GL account, set in a new company preference. I haven't run any of it, since there's nothing to run against.

- **New preference:** "Currency Exchange (Unrealized) GL Account", stored in a new `companies.unrealizedexchangediffact` column. It sits next to the two existing exchange-variance accounts on the Company Preferences page. `CompanyPreferences.php` reads it, saves it and offers the same profit-and-loss account list.
- **Posting:** `AdjustBankAccountsDueToCurrencyExchangeRate()` in `includes/SQL_CommonFunctions.php` now posts the type 36 exchange-difference line to this account. If the setting is empty, it falls back to the sales exchange-variance account.
- **Existing installations:** the new update script `sql/updates/41.php` adds the column. It copies each company's current sales exchange-variance account into it, so postings go to the same account until someone changes the preference. Like the other recent scripts, it records its number only when the run had no errors.
- **Not-yet-upgraded databases:** `includes/GetConfig.php` reads the new column only once the stored update number is 41 or higher. Without that, a database that hasn't been upgraded would fail while loading the company record and never reach the upgrade page.
- **Fresh installs:** `install/sql/tables/companies.sql` has the new column. I added it at the end of the table, because the installer's company insert in `includes/InstallFunctions.php` lists its values by position. That insert now supplies `'5200'` (the same account as the sales variances) for it.
- **Other places that list the company GL accounts:**
  - `GLAccounts.php` now refuses to delete an account that is set as the unrealized account.
  - `Z_ChangeGLAccountCode.php` renames the account in this column too.
  - `Z_CreateCompanyTemplateFile.php` now exports the new account in the template it generates.

I left `sql/demo.sql` alone: it is an old dump at update number 17, so the upgrade scripts bring the demo company up to date.

I skipped the translation files; the new label and help text will appear untranslated until the `.po` files are updated.

I added it at the end of the table, because the installer's company insert in `includes/InstallFunctions.php` lists its values by position. That insert now supplies `'5200'` (the same account as the sales variances) for it.
- **Other places that list the company GL accounts:**
  - `GLAccounts.php` now refuses to delete an account that is set as the unrealized account.
  - `Z_ChangeGLAccountCode.php` renames the account in this column too.
  - `Z_CreateCompanyTemplateFile.php` now exports the new account in the template it generates.

I left `sql/demo.sql` alone: it is an old dump at update number 17, so the upgrade scripts bring the demo company up to date.

I skipped the translation files; the new label and help text will appear untranslated until the `.po` files are updated.
